about.welcome.title: Welcome WOTF
about.welcome.text: The World Olympics Taekwondo Federation (WOTF) is a global organization dedicated to the promotion and development of Taekwondo worldwide. Founded with the vision of unifying Taekwondo practitioners under one global federation, WOTF works to advance the sport through international championships, seminars, and educational programs.
about.about.title: About WOTF
about.about.text: WOTF is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea and operates through a network of national chapters and member organizations spanning Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Africa, and Oceania. The federation is committed to promoting fair play, sportsmanship, and excellence in Taekwondo at all levels.
about.withWotf.title: With WOTF
about.withWotf.text: With WOTF, athletes gain access to world-class training programs, international competitions, and a global network of Taekwondo professionals. Our federation provides the framework for growth, from grassroots development to elite athletic performance.
about.activity.title: Activity & Blueprint
about.mission.title: Mission
about.mission.text: To promote and develop Taekwondo globally through international cooperation, fair competition, and educational excellence.
about.vision.title: Vision
about.vision.text: To be the world's premier Taekwondo federation, unifying practitioners and fostering the spirit of martial arts across all nations.
about.values.title: Core Values
about.values.text: Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Unity, and Perseverance — the five pillars that guide every WOTF initiative.
about.chairman.title: Hello
about.chairman.subtitle: Message from the Chairman
about.chairman.name: Grand Master Moon Dae-sung
about.chairman.message: It is my great honor to lead the World Olympics Taekwondo Federation. Our mission is to bring together Taekwondo practitioners from every corner of the world, fostering a spirit of unity, discipline, and excellence. Together, we will elevate Taekwondo to new heights on the global stage.
